headline: One real problem: Android payments in Germany are failing since this morning's app release.

items.label: Successful orders / hour
items.sentence: Down 14%: Android users in Germany cannot pay since app 3.42 - about EUR 6.9k revenue lost per hour. Roll back or hotfix 3.42.

items.label: User conversion
items.sentence: Down 6%, but innocent: the French campaign brings many first-time visitors; orders are on plan.

items.label: Contribution margin / hour
items.sentence: Not reliable right now: the cost-of-goods feed is only 55% complete.

items.label: Revenue / hour
items.sentence: Slightly below normal (-3%) because of the payment issue, still within the band.

items.label: Traffic (sessions / hour)
items.sentence: Up 4% thanks to the French campaign.

text: Good morning. One issue needs action: since app release 3.42 went out at 09:00, Android users in Germany fail to pay 4 times in 10, which costs about 133 orders and EUR 6.9k revenue per hour. Everything else is either healthy or explained: conversion looks lower only because the French campaign brings extra visitors, and margin is temporarily unmeasurable because the cost feed is incomplete.
